observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — overview post-higiene
observations.content:
Academic low-code MVP: React 19 + Vite + Tailwind frontend; FastAPI + PaddleOCR PP-OCRv6.
Repo: https://github.com/javi2481/idp-ocr-studio.git
Philosophy: orquestar API oficial PaddleOCR 3.x (no inventar motores); sin Docker/DB/colas/auth.
Structure: backend/app/ (ocr, orientation, parsing, routes, schemas, storage) + shim backend/main.py; frontend/src/{components,lib,types}; docs/; tests/fixtures/images/; scripts/dev.ps1|sh.
Tier medium fijo. Rescue angular (_rescue_oriented_lines ±30/45/60/90/180). Export JSON/MD/CSV/TXT + PNG anotado.
Formats: PNG JPG WEBP GIF BMP TIFF ICO PPM AVIF. PDF NO.
Run: .\scripts\dev.ps1 o ./scripts/dev.sh → API :8100 UI :5173.
Smoke: tests/fixtures/images/poster.avif → TRY=-90 WERE=+90.
Ver docs/PRODUCT.md y CHANGELOG.md.

observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — continue on another PC
observations.content:
git clone https://github.com/javi2481/idp-ocr-studio.git
cd idp-ocr-studio
engram import engram-export.json
cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\activate  # o source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -r requirements.txt
# otra terminal:
cd frontend && npm install
# raíz:
.\scripts\dev.ps1   # o ./scripts/dev.sh

Fixtures: tests/fixtures/images/ (poster.avif, etiqueta-2/3.jpeg, nube-manzana.png, nube-corazon.jpeg).
API :8100, UI :5173. Primer arranque: warmup Paddle. Ver docs/PRODUCT.md y README.md.

observations.title: IDP OCR Studio — rescue angular + medium fijo
observations.content:
**What**: _rescue_oriented_lines barre ±30/45/60, ±90, 180; Region.orientation float; UI tier medium fijo; use_textline_orientation≠diagonales.
**Why**: Nubes/diagonales fallaban con solo 0/180 de textline orientation.
**Where**: backend/app/ocr.py, backend/app/orientation.py, frontend components.
**Learned**: E2E nubes ~115s; poster TRY conf 1.0 con segundo pase TextRecognition.

observations.title: Cotejo PaddleOCR implementado P0-P2
observations.content:
**What**: Backlog cotejo: .env.example, text_rec_score_thresh en predict, UI text_det_*, warmup lifespan, /health device, /export/{id}/annotated save_to_img, Run All via inferBatch.
**Why**: Alinear con PaddleOCR 3.x oficial; no inventar APIs (sin det_db_*/use_dilation).
**Where**: backend/app/*, frontend/src/*, README.md, docs/archive/.
**Next**: continuidad vía engram-export + scripts/dev.
